answer:
The enquiry asks for a nine-axis comparison of a direct form-cli call against a guided form-cli session, with the direct and guided routes kept distinct and the other recorded routes (bounded one-turn, fresh rented relay) supplying context. All figures below are measurements from the supplied evidence; qualitative judgments are attributed to the source author at receipts/artifacts/2026-09-18-guided-first-answer.md (sha256 2fd9864a…55ac0). Coverage is limited to the recorded runs of 2026-09-18; no universal ranking is claimed (comparison.json, coverage).

Volume and rented tokens. The guided first answer measured 2,544,568 tokens across 21 provider and 57 host tool calls, but its scope is partial: coordinator through call 21, with closing and landing excluded, and broader usage unobserved (receipts/2026-09-18-direct-vs-guided-form-cli.md). The direct unbounded loop measured 649,462 tokens (638,475 input, 577,522 cached, 60,953 uncached input, 10,987 output) over 9 provider and 20 host calls, with all-reported-models scope (receipts/artifacts/2026-09-18-direct-form-cli-result.json). For context, the bounded one-turn route used 45,966 tokens and the fresh rented relay 27,747 tokens. So the guided route consumed roughly four times the direct route's tokens, but the guided figure is a partial-turn lower bound, not a completed total; I infer the full guided run would be higher, which the evidence does not confirm.

Frequency. The guided route made 21 provider and 57 host calls; the direct route 9 provider and 20 host calls. The bounded route made a single provider call; the relay two. Frequency here is call count within the measured scope, not a rate over time.

Quality. The source author observed that direct was grounded by reading but mis-mapped the question once; bounded reasoned soundly with nothing to check against; guided measured and built. The author notes the machine record leaves semantic quality null in all three, so quality is a reading judgment, not a measurement (historical_author_observations, quality).

Vitality. The author observed that direct and bounded left evidence directories the container forgets, while guided left a door, a receipt with edges into the comparison doc, and a named seam; edges-as-vitality means the connection lands with the content (vitality section).

Trust. The author's seed defines trust as when what others say and do are the same again. The organ's evidence is exactly what each provider did, trustworthy on all three; direct's citations held while its route mapping did not; bounded cannot be checked against the body because it touches none of it; every number has a retained path (trust section).

Traceability. Direct and bounded left an organ directory, result JSON with per-model usage, and rows in the parent transcript; guided left one transcript, the receipt, and nine artifacts. The identity seam is the one place traceability blurred: a Form-launched provider inherited the parent session id and wrote rows into the parent transcript; the named repair is a separate session identity or home (traceability and identity-seam sections).

Sovereignty. The author's seed: a self knows what it wants and does and does not make other less. In direct, Form owned the boundary and nothing inside it; the provider decided everything. In bounded, Form decided what the provider saw. In guided, the arriving mind decided every step and Form supplied evidence through 22 native calls. The author judges bounded the route where the body's own choice shaped the most per rented token; none is the native voice (sovereignty section).

Resonance. The seed: when one thing does and another does the same. Bounded spoke the body's seed definitions back word for word; direct echoed the body's receipts; guided turned toward the goal line when it arrived mid-run. Resonance as felt is not a number and is not claimed (resonance section).

Practical conclusion. For a task where the body must steer what is said per rented token, the bounded route is the most sovereign and cheapest (45,966 tokens, one call); the direct route is a middle ground that grounds in reading but can mis-map; the guided route is the most thorough and traceable but the most token-hungry and only partially measured. The immediate way forward is to fix the named identity seam so a Form-launched provider gets its own session identity, which restores clean traceability for the guided route. A broader paired benchmark across completed guided turns is a separate optional follow-up, since the guided figure is a partial-turn lower bound and broader usage is unobserved.
